settings.intro: If a piece is not right, we will make it right. Here is what you can return, by when, and how to start.

settings.title: 7 days to decide
settings.text: Tell us within 7 days of delivery and we will arrange a return or an exchange.

settings.title: Unused, with tags
settings.text: Pieces must come back unused and in their original packaging, with any tags still attached.

settings.title: How to begin
settings.text: Send us your order number and a photograph if something arrived damaged.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Write to us with your order number within 7 days of delivery. We reply with a return address and the next step; do not send anything back before you hear from us.

settings.question: Who pays the return postage?
settings.answer: We cover it when a piece arrived damaged, faulty or wrong. For a change of mind, return postage is yours.

settings.question: When is my refund paid?
settings.answer: Within 5 to 7 working days of the parcel reaching us and passing a quick check, back to the method you paid with.

settings.question: Can I exchange for a different colour or size?
settings.answer: Yes, subject to availability. If the piece you want is made to order, expect the usual 7 to 10 working days once your return arrives.

settings.question: What cannot be returned?
settings.answer: Custom and personalised pieces, gift cards, and anything that has been used or washed. This does not affect your rights if an item is faulty.
